Hi there,

You used the Carnivore Weekly calculator and picked pescatarian. I'll be honest: our calculator treated that as a carnivore diet with fish, zero carbs and all. That suits some people, but it probably wasn't how you actually like to eat.

So we built something that fits you better.

PescoDial is our new sister site, made for people who eat fish. The free calculator takes about two minutes and gives you daily calories, protein, carbs and fat, plus fish meals per week. You choose the style: Pescatarian Mediterranean (olive oil, beans, whole grains and fish), or Low Carb, Keto or Carnivore.

To thank you for testing it, use code PESCO50 for 50% off. Enter the code at checkout. The free numbers may be all you need, and that's fine too.
